errors.text_span: Стълбовидната диаграма показва честотата, с която различни действия са посочени като възможни начини за ограничаване на „скритата икономика“.
errors.evidence: The description claims the chart shows 'ways to limit the shadow economy'. However, the chart's title is 'Кои от следните действия най-вече отнасяте към явлението “скрита икономика”?' which translates to 'Which of the following actions do you most associate with the “shadow economy” phenomenon?'. The chart shows actions characteristic of the shadow economy, not measures to limit it.

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа списък от десет различни действия
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis contains the list of actions. The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the vertical axis lists the categories (actions) and the horizontal axis represents the numerical values.
The description states there are ten different actions, but the chart displays 12 categories on the vertical axis.
The description claims the categories are sorted alphabetically, which is visibly false.
The description misquotes a category label as 'получаване на покупки' (receiving purchases) instead of the actual 'получаване на подкупи' (receiving bribes).
The description fabricates a category label 'Източник на данъчни задължения' (Source of tax liabilities). The actual label in the chart is '"Източване" на ДДС' (VAT 'draining').

errors.text_span: като цифрите са етикетирани с равномерни интервали в син цвят
errors.evidence: The description states the numbers on the axis are labeled in blue, but they are black or dark grey in the figure.

errors.text_span: Най-високата стълба, представляваща „Наемане на работници / служители с договор...“
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 'Наемане на работници...' as the highest bar. The highest bar in the chart corresponds to 'Неиздаване на фактури / касови бележки' (Not issuing invoices / receipts).

The bar for 'Наемане на работници...' which is incorrectly identified as the highest, reaches a value of approximately 180, not over 200. The actual highest bar ('Неиздаване на фактури...') has a value of approximately 235.
The description mentions 'shading' but fails to specify the most prominent visual feature: that the bars are separated into two groups by color (eight blue bars and four red bars).
